scope.cold_proof: All worker CPU rows present; every observed CPU has checks=last_entries=cpu_hot=0 and contentions<1024; no lock-heat records or delegation/refusal/task activity; accepted measured NO_JIT.
scope.final_counters: Whole provider session, including setup, warmup, measurement and cleanup; not measurement-only.
scope.inputs: Only pipes/ and seek/ KD session.json and kernel.log files.
scope.limits: Final heat alone cannot exclude earlier admission when checks>0. Does not identify why contention samples are sparse, or infer lost images, regressions or admission bugs. Runner acceptance is read from recorded fields, not independently rerun.
scope.ratio_rows: entries/contentions are final unfinished-batch residuals; checks counts completed comparisons. With checks=0 no comparison reset occurred.
scope.status: COMPLETE means all 48 session records and required final diagnostics were collected and parsed; acceptance and cold-admission findings are separate aggregate fields.
